provenance.method: Exact rational bounded linear-loss regularized ERM over all binomial counts and neighbours. Separate full-information Hedge and projected OGD, plus complete ideal iid online-to-batch paths; exponentials are numerical approximations.

data.scope: Exact bounded linear-loss regularized ERM on [-1,1], with complete binomial counts and replacement neighbours. Separate deterministic full-information Hedge/OGD protocol. The online-to-batch bridge averages every ideal independent binary path and uses predictions made before each label. No one selected count, adversarial sequence or leaked post-update loss is a statistical certificate.
